main_subject.description: An adult man with short dark hair and a thoughtful sideward gaze.
main_subject.wardrobe: A plain black technical jacket, black crew-neck top, baggy black trousers, and unbranded black trainers.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing beside the front corner of a parked generic black luxury sedan, hands relaxed at his sides.

composition_elements.setting: Rain-damp rooftop parking deck at night with an abstract foggy city skyline and distant bridge-like lights.
composition_elements.framing: Elevated three-quarter full-body composition, emphasizing wet pavement reflections and the vehicle silhouette.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No named car make, vehicle emblem, license plate, city landmark identification, jacket logo, or readable text.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Cool diffuse city glow through fog, with soft reflected highlights on wet asphalt.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural rain detail, fine grain, realistic vehicle geometry, subdued blacks, and no logo artifacts.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical full-frame fashion editorial photograph of an adult man with short dark hair and a thoughtful sideward gaze. He wears a plain black technical jacket, black crew-neck top, baggy black trousers, and unbranded black trainers, standing beside the front corner of a parked generic black luxury sedan. Set him on a rain-damp rooftop parking deck at night with an abstract foggy city skyline and distant bridge-like lights. Use an elevated three-quarter full-body composition, cool city glow through fog, wet asphalt reflections, natural rain detail, fine grain, realistic vehicle geometry, subdued blacks, and no logo artifacts. Do not name a car make or city, and do not include emblems, license plates, text, or brands.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, speeding, unsafe driving, logo, car emblem, license plate, landmark identifier, readable text, watermark, distorted vehicle, malformed hands, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Identity references must be optional and depict a consenting adult. Vehicle, wardrobe, and rooftop references are replaceable; omit all badges, plates, logos, and location identifiers.
